title: The Covenant of Circumcision

questions.question: What new name did God give Abram?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:5: God changed Abram's name to Abraham.

questions.question: What new name did God give Sarai?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:15: God changed Sarai's name to Sarah.

questions.question: What was the sign of God's covenant with Abraham?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:11: Circumcision was the sign of the covenant.

questions.question: What name did God tell Abraham to give his son?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:19: "You shall call his name Isaac."

questions.question: Did Abraham obey God regarding circumcision?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:23: Abraham circumcised the males of his household that very day.

questions.question: How old was Abram when God appeared and gave this covenant?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:1: Abram was 99 years old when the LORD appeared.

questions.question: What does Abraham mean?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:5: "for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations."

questions.question: What did Abraham do when God said Sarah would have a son?
options: Fell on his face and laughed
questions.correctAnswer: Fell on his face and laughed
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:17: Abraham fell on his face and laughed.

questions.question: At what age should males be circumcised according to this covenant?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:12: Every male shall be circumcised at 8 days old.

questions.question: What did God say would happen to one who was not circumcised?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:14: "that person shall be cut off from his people."

questions.question: What name did God reveal Himself by to Abraham?
How many nations would come from Abraham according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:4-5: "You shall be the father of a multitude of nations."

questions.question: How old was Ishmael when he was circumcised?
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:25: Ishmael was 13 years old when circumcised.

questions.question: What did Abraham ask God regarding Ishmael?
options: Oh that Ishmael might live before you!
questions.correctAnswer: Oh that Ishmael might live before you!
questions.explanation: Genesis 17:18: Abraham pleaded for Ishmael to live before God.

questions.question: How many princes would come from Ishmael according to this covenant?

key_verse_text: 'No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.'
